settlement: Statistical grading distinct from venue settlement

uncertainty_rules.observed_ranking: All actually decided comparable cells are visible, including ties and small samples, but small samples do not meet support eligibility
uncertainty_rules.uncertainty: 95% week-block percentile bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed661107; fewer than5weeks: Wilson interval labelled independent-Bernoulli diagnostic only, not dependence-aware qualification
uncertainty_rules.support_is_not_superiority: Meeting support permits comparison, not a proven winner. Evidence-supported leader additionally needs retained prespecified matched comparison/chronological confirmation and multiplicity/research-exposure review; no automatic promotion from an interval or maximum percentage.
uncertainty_rules.missing_difficulty_evidence: Expose population/line difficulty limitations; no universal category superiority or invented prices
